name: Harry's Honey Pot
description: Harry's Honey Pot is a independent farm in 624 South Darby Road Hermitage, PA. It grows Apples, Pumpkins, Corn, Peppers, and Honey, with seasonal availability through autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Aug – Nov in this growing zone.
